name: vygolint
description: Conformance evaluation of educational games against Carvalho (2020) socio-interactionist guidelines, with WCAG-style A/AA/AAA levels

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate educational games against Vygotskian design guidelines
interface.longDescription: Use vygolint to evaluate an educational game from its code, design documents and gameplay video against the 40 guidelines of Carvalho (2020), producing a WCAG-style conformance report with recommendations.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate this educational game with vygolint.
Does this game meet criterion D17.1?
